description: Renovate is off. It was configured against the Laravel 7 tree and spent years
opening pull requests for that dependency graph — thirteen were still open, all
for packages this repository no longer has.
Turning it back on means deleting `enabled` and letting it re-onboard against
the current backend/ and frontend/ manifests, which it will not do while this
flag is set. Note that a file cannot stop the app from being installed: to remove
it entirely, uninstall Renovate under the repository's GitHub app settings.
